facts.text: The hotel is in Montevideo, by Pocitos Bay.
facts.excerpt: Right in Montevideo, by Pocitos Bay, Costanero Montevideo is a boutique hotel designed for memorable experiences.

facts.text: The rooms are uniquely designed and have sea views.
facts.excerpt: Its uniquely designed rooms are perfect for relaxing with sea views.

facts.text: The hotel has a wellness area with a swimming pool, a gym and a sauna.
facts.excerpt: wellness area with swimming pool, gym and sauna

facts.text: Cauce Restaurant is on the hotel's first floor with a view of the sea and serves mainly Uruguayan and international cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Located on the first floor of the hotel with a stunning view of the Sea, Cauce Restaurant offers a variety of culinary styles, mainly Uruguayan and international cuisine.

facts.text: Cauce Restaurant cooks only with Uruguayan raw materials.
facts.excerpt: It only cooks with Uruguayan raw materials produced with fresh, top quality

facts.text: The restaurant overlooks the sea and the Rambla de Montevideo.
facts.excerpt: Restaurant overlooking the sea and the Rambla de Montevideo

facts.text: Cauce Bar serves tapas, drinks, cafeteria service, snacks, sandwiches, desserts and pastries.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy tapas, drinks, cafeteria service, snacks, variety of cold and warm sandwiches, desserts & pastries

facts.text: The spa offers bespoke treatments and wellness rituals.
facts.excerpt: Escape to a haven of tranquility, where bespoke treatments and refined wellness rituals rejuvenate body and mind.

facts.text: The fitness center offers personalized training.
facts.excerpt: Enhance your workout in our fitness center, which features state-of-the-art equipment, personalized training, and a refined, energetic environment.

facts.text: The Deluxe suite has a king-size bed, a balcony and a sea view.
facts.excerpt: Deluxe suite with 1 king size bed with balcony and sea view

facts.text: The Executive Room has a king-size bed and a sea view.
facts.excerpt: Executive Room with 1 king-size bed and sea view

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly and allows small pets.
facts.excerpt: Pet-friendly hotel in Montevideo! Small pets allowed

facts.text: Up to one child can stay in the same room as the parents.
facts.excerpt: Hotel for families! Up to one child in the same room as the parents

facts.text: The Tristan Narvaja street market takes place every Sunday.
facts.excerpt: Comience su recorrido en la tradicional Feira Tristán Narvaja, una feria callejera que se realiza todos los domingos.

facts.text: Parque Rodo is a place to enjoy the sunset.
facts.excerpt: enjoy the sunset in Parque Rodó
